caveats: This snapshot is supporting occurrence evidence only and cannot measure seagrass meadow area, absence, or decline.
Primary scoring requires comparable curated habitat polygons from at least two mapping periods.
Observer effort, dataset mobilization, and taxonomic coverage vary across regions and years.
failure_behavior: If refresh fails, retain the last reviewed snapshot, mark it stale, and never convert missing records to zero.
